subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They remove old information and add new tips.”?
options: Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.
Before reacting, people should ask one simple question: "Where did this information come from?"
It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Before reacting, people should ask one simple question: 'Where did this information come from?'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They remove old information and add new tips. It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They remove old information and add new tips. It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.」，答案為「It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.」。
